desc:
DELICIOUS TASTE COMBO: The perfect combination of chocolatey and peanut butter flavor in every crunchy bite; Enjoy a bowl with milk as a delicious part of breakfast

REAL REESE'S PEANUT BUTTER: Ready to eat sweet and crispy corn puffs made with real REESE'S Peanut Butter; This cereal for kids and adults is an ideal pantry staple

WHOLE GRAIN: Each serving of this kids breakfast cereal provides 15g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), and has a good source of calcium, with 12 vitamins and minerals

EASY SNACKS: Pack some kids cereal in a school snacks bag or lunch box for a sweet treat; Sprinkle over ice cream or toss some in your favorite peanut butter cereal bars or trail mix recipes

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy REESE'S PUFFS Breakfast Cereal, Chocolatey Peanut Butter Cereal, Mega Size, 29 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Features:

Rich Chocolate and Peanut Butter Flavor: Crispy corn puffs coated with the iconic combination of chocolate and Reese’s peanut butter.

Made with Real Reese’s Peanut Butter: Contains authentic peanut butter, not artificial flavoring.

Crunchy Texture: Stays crispy in milk, offering a satisfying crunch from first bite to last.

Whole Grain Goodness: Delivers about 15g of whole grains per serving, contributing to a balanced diet.

No High Fructose Corn Syrup: Sweetened without HFCS for a cleaner ingredient profile.

Vitamin & Mineral Fortified: Includes essential nutrients like iron, zinc, calcium, and B vitamins

Multiple Size Options: Available in different box sizes for individual or family needs.

Kosher Certified: Suitable for those who follow kosher dietary requirements.

Benefits:

Delicious and Indulgent: Tastes like a dessert cereal inspired by Reese’s Peanut Butter Cups — a treat for peanut butter and chocolate lovers.

Snack-Friendly: Great as a dry snack, lunchbox filler, or on-the-go treat.

Perfect for All Ages: Enjoyed by kids, teens, and adults alike.

Convenient for Busy Mornings: Quick breakfast option that doesn’t sacrifice taste.

Balanced Sweet Treat: Offers flavor with whole grains and added nutrients for a slightly more nutritious indulgence.

Good Value: Comes in resealable or large-sized boxes, making it cost-effective for families.

Long Shelf Life: Maintains crisp texture and fresh flavor over time.
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Sugar, REESE'S Peanut Butter (peanuts, sugar, monoglycerides, peanut oil, salt, molasses, corn starch), Dextrose, Corn Meal, Corn Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, HERSHEY'S Cocoa, Caramel Color, Trisodium Phosphate, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Rosemary Extract. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Tricalcium Phosphate, Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
